purpose: Pre-registered long-horizon study (KSC2026-v16): the whole confirmatory protocol of v14 (confirm.py), the round-2 analyses (confirm_r2.py) and the round-3 experiments (confirm_r3.py) re-run with a longer prediction horizon on NEW seeds and NEW test data. Everything except the horizon and the seeds is taken unchanged from the base configs. Fixed before any data of this study are generated.
horizon_reason: longer than one natural period of the oscillators (2*pi/omega0 = 6.28 s with omega0 = 1 rad/s), about 1.6 periods
all_episodes_use_the_horizon: train, validation, calibration, judge and test episodes all have the same length (steps = horizon_seconds / dt), as in v14
